notes.title: One year anniversary and upcoming update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I can't believe how fast time passed while I've been busy working on the updates.
[b]TCG Card Shop Simulator[/b] has officially been on Steam Early Access for one whole year!

I want to take a quick moment to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone for your support and being part of my solo dev journey. Your feedback, bug reports, and encouragement have really helped me make the game into something far more polished than it was a year ago!

A quick look back at just how far we’ve come together:

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/506517a539d4ca316bf8cfb27725df30c4a7e4be.jpg[/img]
The journey has been long, but it’s far from over. The biggest feature still on the roadmap is the playable card game. It may be the final boss on the roadmap, but I’ve been actively playtesting with physical prototypes, exploring mechanics, and refining the design. It’s not quite ready yet, and will probably take quite a while until it's up to standard, but I’m just as excited as you are to see it added to the game!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/5aa09d4e8abdb47bf79eeabe9629771ee78fdfc1.jpg[/img]
Next week, there will be an update that comes with some QoL improvements, Steam achievements, bug fixes and a little surprise. Stay tuned!

Again, thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means the world to me, and I’m excited for what’s still to come!

notes.title: Early access build 0.60 - Card Grading
notes.content:
Special thanks to the studio involved in this update:
[url=https://thunder-roar.com/]ThunderRoar Studio[/url]

Hi everyone, card grading is finally here, along with a few additional updates and bug fixes!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/898286cea96bf33600e3b1752f2e6d8e755c3b73.jpg[/img]
You can now send cards for grading via The Cardinal's Grading app on the phone. Select up to 8 cards to be graded in a package and wait for them to be sent back. The grading time and price will depend on the service type you choose.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/9e1edb0552eea49cd7208d3a2a763c3c92620af0.jpg[/img]
You can view your graded card in a special album. To access the album, sort it using "Graded" button. Graded card's pricing can be viewed in the price graph screen, select a specific grade to see its market price.

notes.title: Early access build 0.52 - Shop Decoration
notes.content:
Special thanks to the studio involved in this update:
[url=https://thunder-roar.com]ThunderRoar Studio[/url]

Hi everyone, I'm excited to announce a new update that allows you to further personalize your card shop with a variety of customizable features!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/f2d7ab3325aedac9b8b5ebcc1335d3fb3e59a1c6.jpg[/img]
You can now modify the materials for the walls, floor, and ceiling of your card shop. And decorations like posters, statues, plants, etc are available for you to purchase and place within your shop. Make your shop stand out with these decorations and you might attract more customers to come and visit!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/27805eb8e100cab72798129c4e98387c1419c608.jpg[/img]
For even more flexibility, you can also place decorations outside your shop (within a certain range).

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/9b28faecdbb77051b876401feb7414d1891e2c4b.jpg[/img]
A new app, Hobby DECO, has been added to the in-game phone. You can buy all the shop decorations on the app. 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/dd1ee3193201dc87b95fa99d74676cad2e717832.jpg[/img]
All purchased decorations will be automatically stored inside your decoration inventory, so you don't have to manage mountain of packages for decorations. Press C (PC) or RB button (gamepad) to open the decoration inventory.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/76f8acf562ce2d25a036280ef13483cc571cdd21.jpg[/img]
Currently there are a total of 60+ shop materials, 72 posters and 56 decorations. More will be added in future updates.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45081570/ded8f439cea85c15679c6475db66c5b5ceee17c4.jpg[/img]
Notes / Changelist:
-The Controller D-pad should now functions correctly for UI selection
-Hold Right Mouse Button (PC) or RB (gamepad) to temporarily disable snapping when moving object
-Press F (PC) or Left Face Button (gamepad) to flip a poster while moving it
-Decoration can be placed outside the shop (within certain distance)
-Wall, floor, and ceiling materials are separated by Shop Lot A & B, so you can have different materials for both area
Fix bug - unable to close the decoration inventory screen using Esc button
Fix bug - unable to open pause screen after closing decoration inventory screen

I hope you enjoy these new features and continue to create your awesome card shop :)

notes.title: Fascinating new TCG shop simulator doing extraordinarily on Steam
notes.content:
When I was seven, I tore up a Winged Dragon of Ra Yu-Gi-Oh! card. I was moping at the top of the stairs, upset with my brother about something. When his back was turned I ripped the card in half, treating the now-unplayable Egyptian God card as recompense for whatever slight he'd bestowed upon me. I remember this story all these years later because it fills me with regret, and while we have another Winged Dragon of Ra we play with today, I often wonder how much that un-ripped card is worth. Steam's newest simulation hit, TCG Card Shop Simulator, answers that exact question by letting you run a store yourself - and it's exploding on Steam.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
New Steam management sim gives you full control of a TCG shop

notes.title: New Steam management sim gives you full control of a TCG shop
notes.content:
Trading card games are too expensive these days. I recently got back into Magic The Gathering, and the prospect of spending anywhere above $5 for a booster pack makes me physically recoil in fear. You can get better value for your money, but then you're spending an unholy amount of cash on physical cards. Still, nothing beats going into your local shop, browsing the new sets on offer, and playing a couple of games. But if you've always wanted to run your own TCG shop, or get the thrill of opening boosters without spending inordinate amounts of cash, the newly released TCG Card Shop Simulator is answering the call.

notes.title: Early Access Is Launched!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's a little more than a month since the release of prologue version, and now the early access version is finally ready! I've been working extra hard everyday to add more content for the launch, and here are the [b]list of features that are added in the early access version[/b]:

notes.title: Early Access Launch - 25th September 2024
notes.content:
Hi everyone, after much consideration and planning, I've decided to [b]launch TCG Card Shop Simulator next month on September 25 as early access[/b]. The reason for launching much earlier is so that I can involve the players more in the development process during early access, and it will be much more efficient without updating both the main game and the prologue version.

After launching the prologue version, I received a lot of players feedback and I'm much clearer on what features to add or to focus on during development, and I hope to continue with this update and feedback cycle during early access. The early access launch next month will include fully unlocked and updated gameplay content, with more than 2500 cards to collect!

However, the features listed on the roadmap will not be available in the game yet, they will only be added through future updates. During early access, I aim to update the game at least once each month and hopefully with many feedback and updates, the game will progressively evolves into what everyone wanted to play.

Do wishlist the game if you want to be notified as soon as the game launch on September 25:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070070/TCG_Card_Shop_Simulator/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070070/TCG_Card_Shop_Simulator/[/url]

Roadmaps will be displayed on the main screen of the game to let everyone know what is the feature I will be working on. Feel free to post any feedback, ideas or suggestions and I will read them!
